summary: New 2026 CASPEr-electric measured exclusion on the axion-nuclear EDM coupling g_d. Identity, novelty, 95% CL, units/density conventions, numerical envelope (~4e-4 GeV^-2), three disjoint mass windows (m=hf), upward one-sided shading, and labeling all agree with the paper (abstract, conclusion, Fig. 7).

verdict.summary: New 2026 CASPEr-electric measured exclusion on the axion-nuclear EDM coupling g_d. Identity, novelty, 95% CL, units/density conventions, numerical envelope (~4e-4 GeV^-2), three disjoint mass windows (m=hf), upward one-sided shading, and labeling all agree with the paper (abstract, conclusion, Fig. 7).

result_identity.evidence: Paper 2609.07908 abstract/Sec. I-II: ALP dark matter via axion-nuclear EDM coupling g_d on 207Pb; AxionEDM class and g_d [GeV^-2] convention match. Exclusion (not a candidate/best-fit).

novelty.evidence: Conclusion (p.9-10): first Gen-2 CASPEr-e measured 95% CL exclusion at 19-22 neV, distinct from the older 'CASPEr-electric' entry already in the compilation. is_projection=false; Fig. 7 is a new measured result.

confidence_level.evidence: Abstract and Conclusion explicitly state '95% confidence' limit (3.355-sigma for a 5-sigma detection, Fig. 5 caption). confidence_level=0.95 is paper-supported, not a placeholder.

conventions.evidence: g_d [GeV^-2] on GeV^-2 axis; mass = h*f verified (4.6 MHz->19.0 neV, 5.29 MHz->21.9 neV) matching Fig. 7 top axis; rho_DM=0.47 GeV/cm^3 = 3.6e-42 GeV^4 matches p.1; EDM coupling needs no polarization. Fill keeps paper-native values; no improper raw overlay conversion.

numerical_agreement.evidence: Data minima ~3.78-4.2e-4 GeV^-2 match Fig. 7 scalloped lower envelope (~4e-4) and the quoted |g_d|<4e-4. Three extracted bands coincide with Fig. 7's three frequency segments; no points emitted in the gaps.

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNG shows only the new result in color: a thin red column shading continuously UPWARD from the black scalloped lower boundary (~4e-4) to the frame top (fill_between to ax.get_ylim()[1]), consistent with a one-sided upper bound. No invented endpoint bands, no wrong-side shading, no unrelated co-highlight.

visibility.evidence: Mass (~1.9-2.2e-8 eV) and coupling (4e-4 to 1e-2) are on-screen; labeled 'CASPEr-electric (2026)'. Limit is genuinely narrow and sits within SN1987A, but is drawn on top (zorder 31) and properly isolated in the highlighted view; boundaries interpretable.

findings.description: In the full compilation view the new limit is a near-invisible sliver because it is extremely narrow in mass and lies entirely under the stronger SN1987A region.
findings.evidence: AxionEDM.png: only a thin crimson mark plus label near m~2e-8 over the green SN1987A region; highlighted view resolves it correctly.
findings.requested_change: Optional: no change required; if desired, a mass-zoomed inset/axis (x ~ 1.8e-8..2.3e-8) would reveal the scalloped structure. Not blocking.
